name: brahma-modular-chrome-os
description: Brahma - Modular Chrome OS: Next-gen AI-powered browser workspace, floating tools, smart distraction shield, and multi-mode workflows.
author: Suryaansh Tiwari

scripts.build:modules: npm --prefix modules/autocine run build && npm --prefix modules/scribble run build && npm --prefix modules/image-lab run build
scripts.modules:install: npm --prefix modules/autocine install && npm --prefix modules/scribble install && npm --prefix modules/image-lab install
scripts.postbuild: copy background.js dist\background.js && copy manifest.json dist\manifest.json && copy icon48.png dist\icon48.png && copy icon128.png dist\icon128.png
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run verify:dist
